# SAME and ALL_DIFFERENT compare element identity, not property values.
# NULL arguments raise an error, even when other arguments already decide the result.
# Sources: third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-operators.md
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-operators.md
# FinGraph's Knows edges are 10:1->2, 11:2->1, 12:1->1, 13:1->2.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person), (b:Person) WHERE SAME(a, b) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "3"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person), (b:Person) FILTER ALL_DIFFERENT(a, b) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "6"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person WHERE a.id = 1) RETURN SAME(a, a) AS result)
=> "true"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person WHERE a.id = 1) RETURN ALL_DIFFERENT(a, a) AS result)
=> "false"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person)-[:Knows]->(b:Person) WHERE SAME(a, b) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "1"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person)-[:Knows]-(b:Person) WHERE NOT SAME(a, b) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "6"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person), (c:Person)-[f:Knows]->(d:Person) WHERE SAME(e, f) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "4"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person), (a)-[f:Knows]->(b) WHERE ALL_DIFFERENT(e, f) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "2"

# The third argument must participate; ALL_DIFFERENT is stronger than NOT SAME.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person), (b:Person), (c:Person) WHERE SAME(a, b, c) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "3"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person), (b:Person), (c:Person) WHERE ALL_DIFFERENT(a, b, c) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "6"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person WHERE a.id = 1), (b:Person WHERE b.id = 2) RETURN SAME(a, a, b) AS result)
=> "false"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person WHERE a.id = 1), (b:Person WHERE b.id = 2) RETURN ALL_DIFFERENT(a, b, a) AS result)
=> "false"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person WHERE a.id = 1), (b:Person WHERE b.id = 2) RETURN ALL_DIFFERENT(a, b, a, b) AS result)
=> "false"

# Element-returning functions and conditional expressions can supply the operands.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH p = (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person) WHERE e.id = 12 RETURN SAME(PATH_FIRST(p), PATH_LAST(p), a) AS result)
=> "true"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH p = (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person) WHERE e.id = 10 RETURN ALL_DIFFERENT(PATH_FIRST(p), PATH_LAST(p)) AS result)
=> "true"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person WHERE a.id = 1), (b:Person WHERE b.id = 2) RETURN SAME(IF(TRUE, a, b), a) AS result)
=> "true"

# All properties are identical (empty) in HiddenKeys. Every component of a composite key
# participates, and aliases of a base table are distinct graph element tables.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.HiddenKeys MATCH (a:Person), (b:Person) WHERE SAME(a, b) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "3"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.HiddenKeys MATCH (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person), (c:Person)-[f:Knows]->(d:Person) WHERE ALL_DIFFERENT(e, f) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "12"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.CompoundGraph MATCH (a:Compound), (b:Compound) WHERE SAME(a, b) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "3"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.CompoundGraph MATCH (a:Compound WHERE a.tenant = 'a' AND a.id = 1), (b:Compound WHERE b.tenant = 'b' AND b.id = 1) RETURN ALL_DIFFERENT(a, b) AS result)
=> "true"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.AliasedNodes MATCH (a:Author), (b:Reader) WHERE a.id = b.id RETURN COUNTIF(SAME(a, b)) AS result)
=> "0"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person WHERE a.id = 1), (b:Account) RETURN ALL_DIFFERENT(a, b) AS result)
=> "true"

# OPTIONAL MATCH supplies NULL graph elements. Test either position and a later NULL even
# when the first pair differs (SAME) or repeats (ALL_DIFFERENT).
# Only the documented error behavior is asserted; BigQuery's exact message is unverified.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person WHERE a.id = 3) OPTIONAL MATCH (b:Person WHERE b.id = 999) RETURN SAME(a, b) AS result)
=> error:
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person WHERE a.id = 3) OPTIONAL MATCH (b:Person WHERE b.id = 999) RETURN SAME(b, a) AS result)
=> error:
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person WHERE a.id = 1), (b:Person WHERE b.id = 2) OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Person WHERE c.id = 999) RETURN SAME(a, b, c) AS result)
=> error:
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person WHERE a.id = 3) OPTIONAL MATCH (b:Person WHERE b.id = 999) RETURN ALL_DIFFERENT(a, b) AS result)
=> error:
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person WHERE a.id = 3) OPTIONAL MATCH (b:Person WHERE b.id = 999) RETURN ALL_DIFFERENT(b, a) AS result)
=> error:
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person WHERE a.id = 3) OPTIONAL MATCH (b:Person WHERE b.id = 999) RETURN ALL_DIFFERENT(a, a, b) AS result)
=> error:
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person WHERE a.id = 3) OPTIONAL MATCH (b:Person WHERE b.id = 999) RETURN SAME(b, b) AS result)
=> error:
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person WHERE a.id = 3) OPTIONAL MATCH (b:Person WHERE b.id = 999) RETURN ALL_DIFFERENT(b, b) AS result)
=> error:

# Conditional expressions must still short-circuit around an erroneous predicate.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person WHERE a.id = 3) OPTIONAL MATCH (b:Person WHERE b.id = 999) RETURN IF(b IS NULL, TRUE, SAME(a, b)) AS result)
=> "true"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person WHERE a.id = 3) OPTIONAL MATCH (b:Person WHERE b.id = 999) RETURN CASE WHEN b IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE ALL_DIFFERENT(a, b) END AS result)
=> "false"
